h1: Underwater Adventure: Explore Thrilling Activities at the Action Center

blocks.text: Underwater Adventure: Explore Thrilling Activities at the Action Center

Experience the thrill of underwater exploration like never before. Whether you're seeking adrenaline-pumping dives with sharks, mesmerizing encounters in the Stingray Cave, or family-friendly snorkeling adventures, we have something for everyone.

blocks.text: Dive with Sharks
Embark on an Unforgettable Adventure:
blocks.html: Embark on an Unforgettable Adventure:

blocks.text: Dive with Sharks at the Action Center
blocks.html: Dive with Sharks at the Action Center

blocks.text: Are you ready to challenge your senses and immerse yourself in the heart of the ocean's most formidable predators? Dive into the shark pool at the Underwater Observatory Action Center for an adrenaline-pumping encounter like no other.
blocks.html: Are you ready to challenge your senses and immerse yourself in the heart of the ocean's most formidable predators? Dive into the shark pool at the Underwater Observatory Action Center for an adrenaline-pumping encounter like no other.

blocks.text: Led by a seasoned professional diver, this thrilling experience promises an up-close and personal interaction with sharks, stingrays, and majestic manta rays. Feel the rush as you glide through the water alongside these mesmerizing creatures, unrestricted by cages or barriers.
blocks.html: Led by a seasoned professional diver, this thrilling experience promises an up-close and personal interaction with sharks, stingrays, and majestic manta rays. Feel the rush as you glide through the water alongside these mesmerizing creatures, unrestricted by cages or barriers.

blocks.text: Experience Requirements:
blocks.html: Experience Requirements:

items: - Exclusive to holders of valid PADI diving licenses
- Must present valid diving insurance
- Suitable for ages 12 and above

blocks.text: Price: 599 NIS (Includes admission to the Park and AquaDome)
blocks.html: Price: 599 NIS (Includes admission to the Park and AquaDome)

blocks.text: Don't miss your chance to embark on this epic underwater journey. Purchase your tickets now and prepare to dive into the depths of excitement!
blocks.html: Don't miss your chance to embark on this epic underwater journey. Purchase your tickets now and prepare to dive into the depths of excitement!

items: - Diving in the shark pool is suitable for ages 12 and above, in good health, with a valid diving license and insurance.
- Dives are performed in two groups, led and supervised by a guide throughout the experience.

- Please be aware that while an adult (over 21) must accompany children under 18 to the Underwater Observatory, this requirement is not specifically for diving. The accompanying adult must also pay an entrance fee to the Park.
- The Action Center will provide all necessary diving equipment. Participants only need to bring a towel and swimsuit.
- Upon arrival, you will sign a health declaration, after which the diving equipment will be given.

- Health conditions that may prevent participation in this activity include breathing issues, heart conditions, sinus disorders, asthma, ear infections, epilepsy, diabetes, claustrophobia, recent surgery or illness, abnormal blood pressure, drug or medication use, pregnancy, or other medical conditions.
- For participants under 18, a parent or guardian must sign the health declaration form to confirm participation.
- The diving activity starts after a brief and a practice session.
- The duration of the dive is approx. 20 minutes.
- Flying for at least two hours after the dive is forbidden.

- The activity cannot be canceled once booked, and no refunds will be issued. If, for any reason, you are unable to complete the activity due to a pre-existing medical condition, we regret to inform you that you will not be entitled to a refund.
- Due to unforeseen circumstances, the booked and approved activity may be postponed or canceled without prior notice.
- Participants will also receive an entrance ticket + AquaDome.

- If visitors have already purchased entrance tickets to the Park or the AquaDome and then choose to participate in the dive activity, we do not offer refunds for the entrance fees nor deduct the cost from the price of 599 NIS for the dive.

blocks.text: Stingray Cave
Dive into the Stingray Cave - An Unforgettable Experience!
blocks.html: Dive into the Stingray Cave - An Unforgettable Experience!

blocks.text: Prepare for an exhilarating adventure as you dive into our Stingray Cave. It's a unique opportunity for divers of all skill levels to engage with marine life while capturing stunning selfies. Led by our seasoned divers, this activity seamlessly blends snorkeling and scuba diving in a safe environment.

blocks.text: Snorkelling
Snorkel with Confidence!

If you adore snorkeling, you'll love our guided snorkeling adventures at the Underwater Observatory. Join our team of ocean experts as you get up close and personal with sea life, swimming amidst vibrant corals and colorful fish. It's an essential family experience, capturing unforgettable moments on your journey!

blocks.text: Coral 2000
Discover Eilat's Underwater Wonders: Glass Bottom Boat Tour

Be captivated on a great journey by rare fish, coral colonies, and amazing sea creatures in their natural habitat aboard the Coral 2000, an iconic glass-bottomed boat offering unparalleled views of Eilat's vibrant underwater world.
blocks.html: Be captivated on a great journey by rare fish, coral colonies, and amazing sea creatures in their natural habitat aboard the Coral 2000, an iconic glass-bottomed boat offering unparalleled views of Eilat's vibrant underwater world.

blocks.text: Join us for a 35-minute cruise as we glide over the crystal-clear waters of the Red Sea, allowing you to marvel at the breathtaking beauty of Eilat's coral reef. Witness an array of colorful marine life that call this reef home.

blocks.text: Experience the wonder and magic of the Coral 2000 Glass Bottom Boat Reef Tour, a must-do activity for tourists in Eilat since 1999.
